test_title: PYST 4: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Select the correctly spelt word. **
solution: The correct answer is '**Chauvinist**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given Options the correctly spelt word is '**Chauvinist**'. • It means 'a person displaying excessive or prejudiced support for their own cause or group, in particular a man prejudiced against women'. (उग्र राष्‍ट्रवादी, पुरुष-श्रेष्‍ठतावादी) • *Example: She now reports to a new boss, who is a **chauvinist**.* **Correct Answer:**__ *Chauvinist.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of other words: • **Immigrant**: a person who has come into a foreign country to live there permanently. (दूसरे देश में आकर वहीं स्‍थायी रूप से बसने वाला व्‍यक्ति; आप्रवासी) • **Contemporary**: belonging to the same time as somebody/something else. (समकालीन, समकालिक) • **Cosmopolitan**: containing people from all over the world. (विश्‍व के विभिन्‍न भागों से आए व्‍यक्तियों वाला; सर्वदेशीय) 40:T79b, The erroneous part is **'to step into save me'.**
